newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Guoco Holdings 1st half net 335.08 mln peso.
newsitem.headline: Guoco Holdings 1st half net 335.08 mln peso.

text.p: Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc said on Monday its net income in the first half ended December 31, 1996 amounted to 335.083 million pesos.
No comparative figure was given for the same period last year.
Guoco is the local unit of Hong Kong's Guoco Group Ltd.
Its revenues for the first six months totalled 395.239 million pesos, of which 368.990 million pesos came from equity in net earnings of affiliates and 26.249 million pesos as other income.
In the three months from October to December 1996, its after-tax income reached only 15.2 million pesos, the statement said.
In the last fiscal year ended June, 1996, its net profit was at 1.003 billion pesos.
Guoco Holdings has interests in property, ceramic manufacturing, and banking.
The company is also planning to go into hotel and casino operations, and construction.
